svg.text: Figure 3 - Pipeline Timing: EX-to-EX Forwarding, Load-ALU Stall, Bus Wait & RV32M Multi-Cycle Ops

Exact cycle-by-cycle trace from cpu_core + sys_bus_interconnect + imem/dmem slaves | 1 Cycle = 1 Clock Period (10 ns @ 100 MHz) | Stages: IF/ID (Fetch+Decode), EX (Execute/M-Unit), MEM/WB (Bus/Writeback) | tcq propagation delay shown on stages & signals
T25 - T52: Radix-2 Divider (33 cyc stall)
HARDWARE CONTROL SIGNALS & BUS PROTOCOL (RTL cycle-accurate waveforms from sim)
Bus load/store wait in WB stage
- EX-to-EX Forwarding (Green Arrows): T2 (addi x1 -> addi x2), T8 (mul x3 -> add x4), T13 (lw x6 -> add x7), T55 (div x9 -> addi x10). Eliminates RAW bubbles.

- Multi-Cycle & Control: MUL takes 4 cycles in EX (T4-T7). Load-ALU Stall at T12 (1 cycle). Branch taken at T14 squashes single wrong +4 fetch (0x24 at T15); target 0x30 is fetched in T15 while branch is in WB. DIV takes 34 cycles. tcq delay depicted on all transitions.
